name: 90north-develop
description: North's development plugin. n-dev: structured development discipline (design before code, modular functional modules, reuse first, extension files beside existing code, single source of truth, test-first, verified). defect-loop: runs a Jira defect board end-to-end in any repo — pulls every open defect (board and backlog), triages, reproduces each with a red e2e on an isolated stack, finds the root cause, fixes it test-first with n-dev through subagents, verifies with code review + QA, records before/after videos that play inline in the Jira comment, writes the 3-part comment (1. Can it be reproduced? 2. Root cause 3. Solution) and moves the ticket to the QA lane. Project facts live in each repo's .claude/defect-loop/config.md, written by /90north-develop:defect-loop-init.
